Name: FeTK - Stardew-Valley Toolkit
Author: FelixDev
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Please check the [url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods/tree/master/FeTK]mod documentation[/url] for available APIs and how to consume this Stardew-Valley mod toolkit.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
For compatibility issues, please check [url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods/tree/master/FeTK#compatibility]here[/url].

[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods/blob/master/FeTK/release-notes.md]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods/tree/master/FeTK]Source code[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods/blob/master/README.md]My other mods[/url]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Requires SMAPI 2.11.0 or later. See [url=https://github.com/Felix-Dev/StardewMods/blob/master/FeTK/release-notes.md]Release notes[/url].

Manifest.Name: FeTK
Manifest.Description: FeTK is a collection of helper functions and mod services. It simplifies common developer tasks building Stardew-Valley mods and empowers developers to build rich mod experiences.
Manifest.Author: Felix-Dev
